<distribution id="traitedtreeLikelihood.$(n)" spec='tyche.evolution.likelihood.AncestralTypeLikelihood' useJava="true" tag="location" tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'> <input name="nodeTypes" idref="nodeTypes.$(n)"/> <data spec="beastclassic.evolution.alignment.AlignmentFromTrait" id='$(n)'> <userDataType spec='beast.base.evolution.datatype.UserDataType' id='traitDataType.$(n)' states='4' codelength='-1' codeMap='A = 0, B = 1, C = 2, D = 3, ? = 0 1 2 3, - = 0 1 2 3'/> </data> <siteModel spec='SiteModel' id="geoSiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount='1'> <proportionInvariant spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='proportionInvariant.s:$(n)' value='0.0' lower='0' upper='1' estimate='false'/> <mutationRate spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='mutationRate.s:$(n)' value='1.0' estimate='false'/> <shape spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='gammaShape.s:$(n)' value='1.0' estimate='false'/> <substModel spec="tyche.evolution.substitutionmodel.TycheSVSGeneralSubstitutionModel" id="svs.s:$(n)" symmetric='false'> <rateIndicator id='rateIndicator.s:$(n)' spec='parameter.BooleanParameter' value='true' dimension='6'/> <frequencies id='traitfreqs.s:$(n)' spec='Frequencies'> <frequencies id='traitfrequencies.s:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' value='.25 .25 .25 .25'/> </frequencies> <rates id='relativeGeoRates.s:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' value='1.' dimension='6'/> </substModel> </siteModel> <branchRateModel id="StrictClockModel.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.branchratemodel.StrictClockModel"> <parameter id="traitClockRate.c:$(n)" name="clock.rate" value="1.0"/> </branchRateModel> </distribution>
<parameter spec='beast.base.inference.parameter.IntegerParameter' name='nodeTypes' id='nodeTypes.$(n)' dimension="100" value="0" upper="1" lower="0"/>
<logger id='treeWithTraitLogger.$(n)' logEvery="10000" fileName="$(n)_tree_with_trait.trees" mode="tree"> <log id="treeWithTraitLoggerItem.t:$(n)" spec='beastclassic.evolution.tree.TreeWithTraitLogger' tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'> <metadata idref="posterior"/> <metadata idref="traitedtreeLikelihood.$(n)"/> </log> </logger>
<distribution id='geoclockPrior.c:$(n)' x="@traitClockRate.c:$(n)" spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior'> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Gamma' offset="0.0"> <alpha spec='parameter.RealParameter' estimate='false' value='0.001'/> <beta spec='parameter.RealParameter' estimate='false' value='1000.0'/> </distr> </distribution> <distribution id='relativeGeoRatesPrior.s:$(n)' x="@relativeGeoRates.s:$(n)" spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior'> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Gamma' offset="0.0"> <alpha spec='parameter.RealParameter' estimate='false' value='1.0'/> <beta spec='parameter.RealParameter' estimate='false' value='1.0'/> </distr> </distribution>
<operator id='georateScaler.s:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.99" weight="30" parameter="@relativeGeoRates.s:$(n)" scaleAllIndependently="true"/>
<operator id='geoMuScaler.c:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.9" weight="3" parameter="@traitClockRate.c:$(n)"/>
<log id='geoSubstModelLogger.s:$(n)' spec='beastclassic.evolution.substitutionmodel.SVSGeneralSubstitutionModelLogger' model="@svs.s:$(n)" dataType="@traitDataType.$(n)" useLocationNames="true"/>
<operator id="nodeTypesUniformTreeOperator.$(n)" spec="tyche.evolution.operator.LeafConsciousTypeTreeOperator" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="20.0" traitName="$(n)"> <input name="nodeTypes" idref="nodeTypes.$(n)"/> </operator> <operator id="nodeTypesSubtreeTypeSwitchOperator.$(n)" spec="tyche.evolution.operator.SubtreeTypeSwitchOperator" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="20.0" traitName="$(n)"> <input name="nodeTypes" idref="nodeTypes.$(n)"/> </operator> <operator id="nodeTypeHeightOperator.$(n)" spec="tyche.evolution.operator.UniformNodeTypeHeightOperator" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="20.0" traitName="$(n)"> <input name="nodeTypes" idref="nodeTypes.$(n)"/> </operator> <operator id="rootHeightAndTypeOperator.$(n)" spec="tyche.evolution.operator.CombinedRootOperator" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="20.0" traitName="$(n)"> <input name="nodeTypes" idref="nodeTypes.$(n)"/> </operator>
